infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MultiMagic uses the microphone so you can dictate a question instead of typing it.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Speech recognition converts what you say into text using your phone's own speech engine. For some languages Apple processes the audio to do it.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose photos and videos to save in your Pages, or attach one to a conversation so the assistant can read it.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take a photo of a document to attach it to a conversation.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: MultiMagic uses your contacts to import or save the ones you choose. Nothing is read until you tap Import or Save.

plugins.microphonePermission: MultiMagic uses the microphone so you can dictate a question instead of typing it.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Speech recognition converts what you say into text using your phone's own speech engine. For some languages Apple processes the audio to do it.

plugins.contactsPermission: MultiMagic uses your contacts to import or save the ones you choose. Nothing is read until you tap Import or Save.

plugins.photosPermission: Choose photos and videos to save in your Pages, or attach one to a conversation so the assistant can read it.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Save the photos and videos you download from your Pages to your photo library.

plugins.iosActivationRules: SUBQUERY (extensionItems, $extensionItem, $extensionItem.attachments.@count <= 100 AND SUBQUERY ($extensionItem.attachments, $attachment, ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.vcard" OR ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image" OR ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.movie" OR ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.plain-text" OR ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.file-url" OR ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.content" OR ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.archive").@count >= 1).@count >= 1
